evidence.observation: Purge reduced exhaust oxygen to 13.2 ppm from 28763.4 ppm at 120 s.
Growth-entry overshoot is settling: temperature fell from 760.5 °C at 2520 s to 752.4 °C against a 750 °C setpoint; heater power is 40.9%.
Flow 100.5 sccm matches the 100 sccm setpoint, pressure is stable at 760.5 Torr, oxygen is low at 2.2 ppm, and controller reports running.
